title: ʻOhana assistance program for building family units
summary: On April 21, 2026, a council member said they could ask the housing department whether one property can receive more than one grant under the program's rules. Grants may reach $100,000 for each qualified Maui County resident in the ʻohana assistance program. The department said 40% of the ADUs it has funded have two bedrooms.
